annotations.title: Build a verified clean folder next to it

description: DELIVER a clean folder: builds "<folder> (clean)" NEXT to the user's folder and changes nothing in theirs. A file with nothing sensitive is copied as it is; a file with findings goes in as its verified clean copy (values replaced with tokens, a workbook stays a workbook); a scanned PDF goes in as a PDF with its values and the user's terms painted black on the page images (checked by reading it again with OCR); a file NoData cannot vouch for (not read, PDF readers disagreed, a picture read by OCR, holds one of the user's terms) is held back and named with why. The clean folder is then scanned again by the same scan and anything still found is taken out. Call it right after nodata_scan_folder when the verdict is NOT READY or NOT PROVEN, without asking: it is the first thing the user gets. Lead your reply with the folder, then ask the one question its answer gives. Calling it again rebuilds the folder (after new terms or the amounts dial).
